prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Home Intro Welcome Spotlight with Direct Desktop Test']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Photo Quality Assistant and Real-Time Pet Preview', 'Late Sign-In After Pet Adoption', 'Desktop Interaction Modes Screen', 'Desktop Visibility Checklist and Launch Setup']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Account Persistence Warning and Reset Prevention', 'Exclusive Accessory Unlocks Incentive Badge', 'Account Persistence Clarification Layout', 'Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Tutorial', 'Adoption Certificate Celebration Split View', 'Custom Photo Upload Quality Checklist', 'Essential Pet Controls Quick Screen', 'Two-Column Path Choice Redesign', 'Adoption Certificate Name Customization Highlight', 'Compact Sign In Credentials Layout', 'Path Selection Duration and Process Guide', 'Adoption Certificate Starter Pet Perk']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, redesign], [finish, new_screen], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
For [finish, redesign], evidence is mixed across 2 tests: one test won with a +5.1% gain after noise correction, while another showed no clear effect (-1.1% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that performed poorly and stopped early ([adoption, redesign], [sign_in, reorder], and [finish, new_screen]).
Predictions were too high for [finish, redesign] in round 6, where predicted +5.0% resulted in no clear effect (-1.1% after noise correction).
Predictions were too low for the winning [finish, redesign] test in round 4 (predicted +3.0%, actual +5.1% after noise correction).

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Pick Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the pick_friend screen into an interactive stage layout featuring animated previews and sound feedback when highlighting pets.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and high duration (89s median). Giving dynamic visual previews accelerates adoption confidence.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet to preview their idle animations and sound effects before adopting.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In After Initial Pet Choice
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding to place sign_in after pet selection so users choose their pet companion before creating an account.
candidates.why: Early sign_in drop-off (72.9%) happens before users build an emotional bond with a pet. Moving sign_in right after pick_friend leverages pet selection momentum.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet Companion to the Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet selection and sync progress across devices.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Readiness Diagnostic Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new diagnostic verification screen during the waiting sequence that verifies overlay display permissions and desktop positioning.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to launch. Verifying desktop setup before spawn prevents silent failures.

new_desktop_diagnostic.headline: Desktop Display & Overlay Test
new_desktop_diagnostic.body: Checking system permissions to make sure your pet can roam freely on top of desktop windows.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Control Practice Flow
candidates.change: Transform the home_intro screen into a interactive spotlight flow where users practice summoning, hiding, and dragging their pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to hide or talk to pets, and finish duration is high (395s median).

home_intro.headline: Try Your Pet Controls Now
home_intro.body: Click on your desktop pet to open commands, drag to move, or right-click to hide.

components.text: Right-click your pet anytime to access options or send them to the system tray.

candidates.title: Real-Time Generation Step Breakdown
candidates.change: Display explicit stage milestones with dynamic time estimates while generating the custom pet on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to believe the app stalled during rendering.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Custom Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Building 3D meshes, rendering animations, and optimizing desktop performance.
waiting.hint: This takes around 1-2 minutes. Your pet will spawn automatically when finished.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Banner
candidates.change: Add clear image requirements and contextual lighting hints directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results due to poor input photos.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit frontal photos with a single subject for best AI generation results.

components.text: Tip: Avoid blurry images, group photos, or heavy filters.

candidates.title: Path Selection Duration Clarification
candidates.change: Clarify path titles and time estimates on choose_path so users understand the fast pre-made path versus custom generation.
candidates.why: choose_path drops 23.8% of users and has an 8s median / 514s mean time, indicating hesitation on which path to select.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Adoption Experience
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play pet (1 min setup) or create a custom pet from photos (3 min setup).
choose_path.hint: You can always create additional custom pets later from the main app menu.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Benefit Spotlight
candidates.change: Highlight account binding benefits and persistent pet recovery directly above sign-in options.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or account resets after signing back in, showing lack of clarity around account linking.

sign_in.headline: Link Account to Prevent Pet Loss
sign_in.body: Signing in binds your adopted pets safely to your account so you never lose them when switching devices.

candidates.title: Background Rendering Readiness System Alert
candidates.change: Enable optional background notifications on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during rendering.
candidates.why: High mean wait time (2336s) causes users to close or abandon the app while waiting for pet asset generation.

waiting.headline: Feel Free to Minimize
waiting.body: We'll notify you desktop-side as soon as your pet is ready to leap onto your screen.

candidates.title: Grid Overview Layout for Pet Choices
candidates.change: Switch the pick_friend screen layout from default to a grid layout displaying pet personality tags.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%). A structured grid reduces scroll friction and speeds up decision-making.

pick_friend.headline: Explore Companion Characters
pick_friend.body: Compare pet traits and pick the companion that best matches your desk vibe.
